answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. The pearl of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the velvet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
